sentences.text: Director David Lynch appears in an uncredited cameo as a spice worker, while Danny Corkill is shown in the onscreen credits as Orlop despite his scenes being deleted from the theatrical release.
Anya Taylor-Joy makes an uncredited cameo appearance as Alia Atreides, Paul's unborn sister who appears in his premonitions.
Producers kept Anya Taylor-Joy's cameo as Alia discreet until the London premiere of the film in February 2024.
Taylor-Joy had appeared as Alia in an uncredited cameo in Dune: Part Two.
